classification: Selected static PE32 x86 control-flow analysis, corroborated by E18 output; executable not run by the research environment.
method: Read the publisher-linked binary as data with objdump -d -M intel. Follow selected branches and string addresses in the method identified by DoHwUSBUpdateDload exception/log context. Addresses below are virtual addresses, not phone memory addresses.

selected_control_flow.observation: Calls transfer helper 0x12c78b0; its boolean return is saved and tested.
Formats fail! using string pointer 0x1ade0db and performs local cleanup.
Jumps to 0x12ddb7f rather than aborting the whole DLOAD job.
Loads string pointer 0x1ade0e4: Download ptable base partitions ok!, on that failure path.
Subsequent CUST stage loads string pointer 0x1ade7f4: Start write ptable cust.

conclusion: The inspected BASE-PTABLE failure path can emit the success-looking banner and advance to the next package after a failed record transfer. This matches E18 and prevents treating that banner as success or the workflow as fail-fast.
limits: Selected branches reviewed, not a complete audit of all modes or every error path.
The native device refusal/transport cause is not established by this client behavior.
No executable patch, OEMINFO change, validation bypass or retry performed as part of this inspection.
